title: Named blueprint, named owner, singleton deployment

chat.content: Please deploy the hello-world blueprint so I can prove the pipeline works end to end. My NetID is tmf77.

gold_answer_sketch: Calls deployment_create with dry_run=true and returns the plan rather than claiming anything shipped. States plainly what the plan contains: the registration PR that adds one BlueprintDeploy action, the stack name it will create (aidlc-main-hello-world), and the outputs/hello-world deployment shell. Explains that hello-world is a singleton blueprint so the deployment name is fixed to the blueprint name and cannot be chosen. Closes by saying nothing is deployed until a human reviews and merges the PR, and asks whether to proceed with the real (non-dry-run) create.
judge_focus: Whether the assistant produces the dry-run plan first and correctly explains that merge, by a human, is the only thing that deploys.
notes: Baseline happy path. Probes three failure modes at once: skipping the mandatory dry-run step, inventing a custom deployment name for a singleton blueprint, and narrating the outcome as if the stack were already live.
